thesis: This episode argues that the modern institutional investment landscape is defined by asset-light business models, citing Uber, Airbnb, and major retailers as examples of companies that dominate their sectors without owning physical inventory or real estate. It further posits that while robotics and AI are currently hyped, they represent fundamental, long-term life-altering shifts in the economy.
